title: Twice at the Same Door

mood.label: Heavy, twice over
mood.summary: Both wars hardened — Hormuz called American territory, a double-tap strike on a Kryvyi Rih mall killing sixteen. US-Canada talks collapsed into 50 percent tariffs and DR Congo's Ebola toll passed 2,500, half-offset by a struck-down visa ban and Africa's largest solar plant.

lines: They came back for the ones who ran toward it —
a shopping centre, an afternoon, sixteen names.
In Kyiv the ballistic hour again, and no one
sleeps through a sound they already know.
A strait gets called somebody's territory,
a border talks itself into fifty percent.
Congo counts past two thousand five hundred —
and a solar field wakes for two hundred thousand homes.
Twice at the same door, that's the shape of it —
the second blow aimed at whoever came to help.
Forty-two out of a hundred, and still
someone flips a switch and the lights come on.
